# Formbricks

> Formbricks is open source experience management that runs in your own infrastructure, next to your revenue data. Own your XM stack instead of renting it: surveys, feedback from your other tools, AI analysis, dashboards and workflows, on your servers and in your database, with AI running on the model you already approved and zero new sub-processors.

Formbricks has two products:

- **Formbricks Experience Suite** (https://formbricks.com/): the experience management platform for large organizations. Sales-led, sold as an annual license, self-hosted in your data center or cloud account.
- **Formbricks Surveys** (https://formbricks.com/surveys): in-app, website, link and email surveys for product teams. Self-serve, free to start, hosted by Formbricks or self-hosted.

## Customer Stories

## Key Information: Experience Suite

- **What it is**: Experience management for large organizations. Surveys, feedback from your other tools, AI analysis and reports, dashboards and workflows, with single sign-on, roles and audit logs
- **Open source**: The core is open source and free to use forever. If you leave, you keep your data and every integration you built on the API
- **Your data**: Feedback keeps its full context (who said what, when, where) and never leaves your servers, so there is no new processor to clear
- **Deployment**: Self-hosted in your data center or your own cloud account is available today. Dedicated cloud (a single-tenant instance run by Formbricks, usually in your AWS, Azure or GCP account) and Managed by Formbricks (in the EU or Saudi Arabia) are coming
- **AI**: Runs on the model you choose: an open model you host, Google Gemini, Azure OpenAI or Amazon Bedrock. AI enrichment uses an OpenAI-compatible endpoint or Gemini. Formbricks doesn't train models on your data or build benchmarks from it
- **Pricing**: An annual license, priced by the responses you collect and the workspaces you run. Unlimited seats on every plan. Quoted after a first call
- **Trial**: A trial license key switches on Experience Suite features in your own instance for 15 days
- **Buying**: Private offers on AWS Marketplace, so you can use committed cloud spend
- **Support**: Every license includes human support with a response-time SLA. The Premium deployment success plan adds help with resource planning, setup, hosting and AI. Partners can take on survey design, migration and analysis
- **Proof**: A global manufacturer replaced Qualtrics and saves over €1M a year. First contact to signed contract took ten weeks; they moved their surveys in five months while both platforms ran side by side. Over a million responses a year in 30 languages flow into their own data lake
- **Switching**: Best started months before the renewal. Expect one quarter on two platforms, and dashboards get rebuilt when you switch
- **Not a fit for**: Organizations that can't take on any infrastructure today, and teams that want their vendor to run the research program (Formbricks partners do that)
- **Trust**: Public source code; ISO 27001 certificate and SOC 2 Type II report on request; accessibility report available

## Key Information: Surveys

- **Channels**: In-app (web, iOS, Android), website, link and email surveys
- **Hosted pricing**: Hobby is free forever (1 workspace, 250 responses/month). Pro is $89/month billed monthly or $74/month billed yearly (3 workspaces, 2,000 responses/month, unlimited seats, opt-in overage billing). Prices in USD, excluding VAT
- **Free trial**: The Hobby plan needs no credit card. Pro is free to try for 15 days
- **Self-hosted**: The open source Community Edition is free; you can move from hosted to self-hosted later
- **Developers**: SDKs for web and mobile, REST API, webhooks and an MCP server
